text:
5 Travel Poems by G David Schwartz
Travel Times
In travel times
You can sing rhymes
And you can tap your toe
And you can just go, go, go
~~
The Earth Is Always Traveling
The earth is always traveling
But only just around
And I think it is interesting
That this big thing
Doesn’t make a sound
~~
I Like Traveling With My Wife
I like traveling with my wife
It is always nice
She doesn’t make me do the laundry nor diches’
And occasionally I do get kisses
She’s always send me
Around the whole earth
And I just love being there with her.
~~
You Can’t See Flowers
You can’t see flowers
Like ours in our garden
When you’re walking down Broadway
or out in Tucson
We can’t see oceans, nor mountains
When we’re in the Cincinnati Fountains
But nor can they see me
~~
I’ve Never Been To Red River Gorge
I’ve never been to Red River Gorge
But I hear it is gorgeous
So I do believe
One day I ought to get.
